purpose: Add a small, fully sourced current-film batch while the broader ingestion pipeline is established.
selectionCriteria: Released 2025 films with an authoritative first-party source and no normalized title/year/type match in the existing catalog.
limitations: The intended batch was capped below 40 because only first-party facts reviewed during this implementation were accepted.
No external rating values, poster URLs, or where-to-watch claims were added.
Existing legacy duplicate candidates are documented separately and require URL consolidation decisions.
